item.description:
# UsageTopbar 0.8.1-beta.1（57）
- 精简重置图例，只保留类别名，移除重复的图形描述与整图悬停说明。 - 更新菜单不再重复显示当前通道，测试版提醒放在选项悬停提示中。 - 缩短更新错误信息，保留失败原因、重试指引与无障碍信息。
测试版可能不稳定。正式通道仍为0.8.0（56）。本次未改变重置判定、代理或更新安全机制。
验证范围：本地图表、Release/Testing双配置离屏、更新器策略、通道选择、正式身份arm64构建与签名/包检查。公开下载与CI结果以发布验收记录为准。未执行真实前台通道点击、退出重开或下载安装全流程。沿用ad-hoc签名，未经过Apple公证；未替换本机安装。
# UsageTopbar 0.8.1-beta.1 (57)
- Simplify reset legend labels and remove repeated icon descriptions and chart-wide tooltips. - Remove the duplicate selected-channel label; keep the beta warning on the option tooltip. - Shorten update errors while retaining failure reasons, retry guidance and accessibility information.
Beta releases may be unstable. Stable remains 0.8.0 (56). Reset classification, proxy handling and update security are unchanged.
Validation covers local chart tests, Release/Testing offscreen UI, updater policy, channel selection, production-identity arm64 build and signature/package checks. Public-download and CI outcomes are recorded separately. Foreground channel clicks, actual quit/reopen and end-to-end download/install have not been tested. Ad-hoc signed without Apple notarization. The locally installed app was not replaced.

# Usage Topbar 0.8.0（56）正式版
- 更新通道：默认正式版，可选择测试版并保持选择；使用语义版本和递增构建号防止降级。切换会取消旧候选，恢复下载也重新检查通道。继续使用原有签名、身份与包校验。 - 重置判断：同账号额度恢复至100%、尚未到旧预定自然重置时间且完整卡证据一致时，可跨断档推断特殊重置。明确用卡优先；跨旧日期或证据缺失保持未知。未知的已观察恢复显示绿条和回转箭头，自然重置使用时钟回转，普通断网不标记重置。历史只派生重算，不覆盖原始记录。 - 代理与重连：子进程继承明确代理环境并读取系统静态代理；配置变化及请求错误可重新连接。未修改系统网络设置；PAC和仅由特定客户端内部处理的路由不能由此保证支持。
审查修复了恢复下载绕过通道过滤、元数据不一致误报最新、错误文字遮挡图例；历史派生缓存按数据版本与账号失效。
本版使用正式发布身份；本机未替换安装。正式与测试发布使用对应的已签名发布元数据。签名为开发用ad-hoc，不是Developer ID公证。隔离模拟、离屏及本地验收范围见候选验收报告，不能代替真实账号长期运行体验。特殊重置属于按上述证据规则的推断，不代表知道断档中的精确事件时刻。
## 本地补测与验收限制 / Validation limits
当前353点历史副本重复绘图100次，中位1.56ms、P95 1.69ms；合成4万点中位36.61ms、P95 40.63ms。测量为820×280位图上的单次HistoryChartView.draw，不包含屏幕合成。4万点首次完整派生约4.77ms；低于0.001ms仅为缓存命中。
Current 353-point snapshot: 100 offscreen draws, median 1.56ms, P95 1.69ms. Synthetic 40,000 points: median 36.61ms, P95 40.63ms. These measure one draw into an 820×280 bitmap, excluding display composition. Initial full derivation takes about 4.77ms at 40,000 points; sub-0.001ms values are cache hits only.
15项本地回归、双配置离屏、arm64构建和签名/包检查通过。前台通道点击、实际退出重开、图标前台交互与本版真实下载/安装全流程未验证：菜单栏AX超时，随后Mac连接中断。实际隔离候选浮层已启动并查看。无Developer ID/公证、长期真实账号或PAC路由保证。
15 local test commands, both configurations offscreen, arm64 build and signature/package checks passed. Foreground channel clicks, actual quit/reopen, foreground icon interaction and this version's end-to-end download/install remain unverified due to menu-bar AX timeout followed by connection loss. The isolated candidate floating UI was launched and inspected. No Developer ID/notarization or long-running real-account/PAC guarantees.
# Usage Topbar 0.8.0 (56) stable release
- Update channels: Stable by default, with a persistent Beta option. Semantic versions plus increasing build numbers prevent downgrades. Switching cancels old candidates; resumed downloads are revalidated. Existing feed, signature, identity and package validation remain enabled. - Reset classification: full recovery before the previously saved natural deadline with complete unchanged card evidence may infer a special reset across a gap for the same account. Explicit redeemed-card evidence takes priority. Missing evidence or gaps crossing the old deadline remain unknown. Observed unknown recoveries get a green band and circular arrow; natural resets use a clock arrow. Ordinary outages have no reset marker. Replay is derived without rewriting raw history. - Proxy/reconnection: subprocesses preserve explicit proxy variables and can inherit static system proxy settings. Configuration changes and request errors reconnect. No network settings were changed. PAC and client-internal routing remain limitations.
Review fixes cover resumed downloads bypassing channel filtering, inconsistent metadata being reported as up to date, and error text overlapping the legend. Derived history is cached by revision and account.
This stable release uses the production identity. The local installed app was not replaced. Releases use matching signed channel metadata. Signatures are ad-hoc development signatures, not Developer ID notarization. See the candidate acceptance report for isolated, offscreen and local UI evidence; these do not establish long-running real-account performance. Special resets remain evidence-based inferences without an exact event time across gaps.

Foreground channel clicks, actual quit/reopen, foreground icon interaction and this version's end-to-end download/install remain unverified due to menu-bar AX timeout followed by connection loss. # Usage Topbar 0.7.3
收紧重置分类的证据边界：历史采样继续保存当时的预定重置时间；缺测期间即使前后卡列表相同，也不据此推断未用卡或特殊重置。连续新鲜观测支持的提前重置、到期重置，以及明确用卡证据仍按对应类型显示。未知记录不强加标志或绿条，历史回放使用同一规则。
修复测试中固定旧版本号的问题，使用独立版本元数据验证，并将恢复与回放检查接入 GitHub Actions。
Tighten reset evidence boundaries: matching card snapshots across an unseen interval do not prove that no card was used. Preserve each sample's scheduled deadline, classify supported fresh observations and redeemed-card evidence, and leave uncertain history unmarked. Fix stale version assertions using independent fixture metadata and include recovery/replay checks in CI.
安装前额外核验应用 Bundle ID 和清单/包内 build，拒绝缺失或不一致的更新包，保留原签名验证。旧版本在首次升级前仍使用其原更新器。
The patched installer validates exact bundle identity and appcast/package build while retaining signature verification. Older installations retain their original updater until upgraded.
0.7.3（build 55），Apple Silicon arm64，macOS 13+。沿用 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证。
